units.source_text: 身穿带家徽礼服的一行人端正地坐定以后，主笔便致开幕词。

en.t: After the party in formal robes bearing family crests had seated themselves properly, the chief writer gave the opening address.

units.source_text: 将棋盘摆在大厅中央时，在座的人都倒吸了一口气。

en.t: When the shogi board was placed in the center of the hall, everyone present drew in a breath.

units.source_text: 名人平时面对棋盘的习惯又表现了出来，他轻轻地把左肩耷拉下来。

en.t: The Master's usual habit when facing the board appeared again, and he gently let his left shoulder droop.

units.source_text: 他那双瘦小的膝盖显得单薄。

en.t: His thin, small knees looked frail.
The fan, however, was extremely large.

units.source_text: 大竹七段合上眼睛，前后左右摇晃着脑袋。

en.t: Otake, seventh dan, closed his eyes and swayed his head back and forth and from side to side.
